about: Onchain reads behind the directory's reproduced observations. Each read names its chain, its block and the result recorded on retrieval; every block it depends on is pinned by hash. A stock dated D is the state at 00:00 UTC on D, read at the last block before then; a flow over a period covers every block whose timestamp falls in it. Re-run with onchain.mjs against any archive node; see README.md.
